clinical.citation: A Novel Human CAMK2A Mutation Disrupts Dendritic Morphology and Synaptic Transmission, and Causes ASD-Related Behaviors (PMID: 28130356)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo mutation identified in proband with ASD diagnosis; functional studies showed dominant-negative effects on CaMKIIα autophosphorylation and substrate phosphorylation; reduced binding to ASD-linked proteins (Shank3, NMDA receptors, L-type calcium channels); knock-in mice exhibited ASD-related behavioral phenotypes

clinical.citation: Deletion of a Single Lysine Residue at Position 292 of CAMK2A Disrupts Protein Function, Causing Severe Epileptic Encephalopathy and Intellectual Disability (PMID: 37510258)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo heterozygous in-frame single amino acid deletion; exome sequencing; predicted to affect protein structure and function and interaction with other proteins; hits crucial functional site; fully correlated with patient phenotype; first report of inframe single amino acid deletion in IDHD53

clinical.citation: Remote spatial memory deficits in mouse models of neuropsychiatric disorders with immature dentate gyrus phenotype (PMID: 40847814)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: Mouse model with heterozygous knockout of Camk2a; demonstrates behavioral phenotype relevant to neuropsychiatric disorders including intellectual disability, schizophrenia, and autism

clinical.citation: ASHG 2023 - Deciphering the genetic architecture of autism spectrum disorder using chromosomal microarray and whole exome sequencing in patient-parent trios in India (J. Shah et al.)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo SNV identified in WES of patient-parent trio; CAMK2A listed among previously known ASD genes with de novo variants; part of systematic study showing de novo variants as major cause of ASD

model_organism.citation: Adult Camk2a gene reinstatement restores the learning and plasticity deficits of Camk2a knockout mice. (PMID: 36304100)
A hyper-activatable CAMK2A variant associated with intellectual disability causes exaggerated long-term potentiation and learning impairments. (PMID: 40140673)
Calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II α and β differentially regulate mammalian sleep. (PMID: 39757286)
Prefrontal cortex molecular clock modulates development of depression-like phenotype and rapid antidepressant response in mice. (PMID: 39179578)
phenotypes: Dysregulated circadian rhythm in medial prefrontal cortex

model_organism.citation: Neuronal PAC1 deletion impairs structural plasticity. (PMID: 40628313)
phenotypes: Elevated neuronal nitric oxide synthase expression

model_organism.citation: Interactome Analyses implicated CAMK2A in the genetic predisposition and pharmacological mechanism of Bipolar Disorder. (PMID: 31150948)
ASHG 2023 - Defining the role of MeCP2e1 in Rett Syndrome symptom progression (V. Haghani, D. Yasui, O. Sharifi, I. Korf, J. Lasalle)
phenotypes: Altered gene expression in Camk2a neurons

biological.citation: Anti-seizure gene therapy for focal cortical dysplasia (PMID: 38100333)
biological.summary: CAMK2A promoter used to drive neuron-specific expression of engineered potassium channel (EKC) in AAV9 vector for gene therapy in focal cortical dysplasia mouse model. CAMK2A promoter biases expression towards principal neurons, resulting in ~64% reduction in seizure frequency when EKC transgene delivered to dysplastic region.

biological.citation: Corticotropin-releasing hormone neurons control trigeminal neuralgia-induced anxiodepression via a hippocampus-to-prefrontal circuit (PMID: 38241377)
biological.summary: CAMK2A-expressing neurons in ventral hippocampus identified as source of excitatory synaptic transmission to medial prefrontal cortex CRH+ inhibitory neurons. Inhibition of vHPC-CAMK2A to mPFC-CRH circuit ameliorated pain-related anxiodepression, demonstrating functional role in pain-related psychiatric phenotypes.

biological.citation: De Novo Mutations in Protein Kinase Genes CAMK2A and CAMK2B Cause Intellectual Disability (PMID: 29100089)
biological.summary: Identified 19 de novo CAMK2A variants in 24 unrelated individuals with intellectual disability through whole-exome sequencing. Variants affected CAMK2 auto-phosphorylation at Thr286/Thr287 and neuronal migration, establishing importance of tightly regulated CAMK2A auto-phosphorylation in human brain development and synaptic plasticity.

biological.citation: Combining NGN2 Programming with Developmental Patterning Generates Human Excitatory Neurons with NMDAR-Mediated Synaptic Transmission (PMID: 29791859)
biological.summary: CAMK2A::GFP reporter gene used to identify well-differentiated, excitatory glutamatergic neurons in human patterned induced neuron (hpiN) cultures derived from pluripotent stem cells. CAMK2A+ neurons exhibited greater functionality including NMDAR-mediated synaptic transmission.

biological.citation: Cell type-specific biotin labeling in vivo resolves regional neuronal and astrocyte proteomic differences in mouse brain (PMID: 35614064)
biological.summary: Camk2a-neuron proteome characterized using cell type-specific biotin labeling (TurboID) in transgenic mice. Over 2000 neuron-derived proteins quantified including synaptic proteins, transporters, and ion channels, with brain region-specific proteomic differences identified within Camk2a+ neurons.

biological.citation: circADAMTS6 via stabilizing CAMK2A is involved in smoking-induced emphysema through driving M2 macrophage polarization (PMID: 38936066)
biological.summary: CAMK2A mRNA stabilized by circADAMTS6 via IGF2BP2 interaction in macrophages, leading to CREB activation and M2 macrophage polarization in smoking-induced emphysema. CAMK2A knockdown reversed M2 polarization and protected against cigarette smoke-induced emphysema in mice.

biological.citation: Prefrontal cortex molecular clock modulates development of depression-like phenotype and rapid antidepressant response in mice (PMID: 39179578)
biological.summary: Selective Bmal1 knockout in CaMK2a excitatory neurons of medial prefrontal cortex revealed that functional mPFC molecular clock is essential for depression-like phenotype development and ketamine antidepressant effects. CAMK2a+ neurons identified as key cell type for mood regulation and plasticity-related slow wave activity.

biological.citation: CaMK2A/CREB pathway activation is associated with enhanced mitophagy and neuronal apoptosis in diabetic retinopathy (PMID: 40216954)
biological.summary: CaMK2A/CREB signaling pathway activation demonstrated in diabetic retinopathy mouse model and high-glucose-treated retinal ganglion cells. CaMK2A knockdown or CREB phosphorylation inhibition attenuated mitophagy, apoptosis, and neurotransmitter depletion, suggesting CaMK2A/CREB as therapeutic target.

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - IBD-focused eQTL analysis identifies an increased rate of IBD GWAS colocalizations and novel target genes using diseased tissue compared to normal tissue eQTL
biological.summary: First candidate target gene identified for CAMK2A locus through novel eQTL colocalization with IBD GWAS loci using diseased colonic tissue from 190 IBD patients. eQTL mapped in IBD tissue were >2 times more likely to colocalize with IBD GWAS loci compared to normal tissue eQTL.

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - Deciphering the genetic architecture of autism spectrum disorder using chromosomal microarray and whole exome sequencing in patient-parent trios in India
biological.summary: De novo SNV in CAMK2A identified in autism spectrum disorder patient cohort from India (101 patient-parent trios). CAMK2A listed among previously known ASD genes with de novo variants detected, supporting role in synaptic formation and neurodevelopment.
